canary.policy: Only concepts present in the production final AssistantContext pack can satisfy a covered profile. Evaluation-gated fallback profiles cannot self-promote without a new benchmark decision.

deletionBlockers: The frozen six-scenario global retirement gate is not passed because the product-design scenario still has a critical product.user-job gap.
Model answer quality was not measured; retrieval/context evidence must not be reinterpreted as proof of complete answer quality.
Several Skill directories contain auxiliary scripts, detailed references, templates, or workflows outside the frozen corpus and not yet migrated to typed Forge capabilities.

remainingObligations: Product-design/user-job semantics for the retained fallback scenario.
Whole-app plan/debug/audit/test/verify workflows are broader than the frozen corpus.
scan_swift_patterns.py and report/test templates have not been migrated or independently proven unnecessary.

typedForgeCoverage: Xcode build and Simulator execution through existing iOS typed capabilities
normal Cognitive delivery of evaluated SwiftUI state/performance/accessibility principles
remainingObligations: Instruments trace recording and trace-analysis scripts are not represented by an equivalent typed Forge capability in this evaluation.
Detailed SwiftUI references outside the frozen state/performance/accessibility scenarios remain unbenchmarked.

typedForgeCoverage: Repository build/test execution through existing process and iOS capabilities
normal Cognitive delivery of evaluated isolation/MainActor/Sendable/task-entry principles
remainingObligations: Actors, async algorithms, Core Data, memory management, testing, threading, migration, and other detailed references were not all exercised by the frozen corpus.
Physical deletion requires either explicit migration or broader held-out evidence for these reference obligations.

typedForgeCoverage: normal Cognitive delivery of evaluated token/governance/system-first/single-source-of-truth principles
repository build and Simulator validation through existing typed iOS capabilities
remainingObligations: Fine-grained asset, color, spacing, typography, theme, component-style, and migration references remain outside the frozen corpus.
The bundled template/metadata and detailed governance references have not been independently migrated or proven unnecessary.

retirementDecision.rationale: Cognitive Knowledge plus the bounded canary removes repeated semantic Skill reads for the five covered scenarios, but the global gate still has one critical product-design gap and the Skill directories retain auxiliary obligations outside the frozen corpus.
rollback: Revert the Knowledge-first canary commit to restore pre-canary context behavior.
Retained local Skill directories remain available because this Plan performs no deletion.
If a covered domain later emits a critical gap, treat it as fallback until a new benchmark/canary decision is accepted.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Teach or otherwise admit a portable product.user-job principle, then rerun the unchanged product-design scenario and global gate.
Migrate SwiftUI Instruments procedures to typed capability or explicitly retain that auxiliary tool surface.
Expand held-out coverage for concurrency and design-system reference obligations before considering physical directory deletion.
Add model-answer-quality canary evidence before treating retrieval equivalence as full behavioral equivalence.
